dishes.name: Cassoulet
dishes.desc: Slow-baked casserole of white beans, Toulouse sausage and duck confit under a golden crust. The signature dish of the Toulouse area and of Languedoc.

dishes.name: Toulouse sausage
dishes.desc: Coarse pork sausage seasoned only with salt and pepper, grilled and served with lentils or mash. The sausage that goes into every cassoulet.

dishes.name: Candied violets
dishes.desc: Violet flowers crystallised in sugar, made in Toulouse since the 19th century. Sold as sweets and used in cakes and chocolates around the city.

dishes.name: Chicken à la toulousaine
dishes.desc: Chicken stuffed with sausage meat and roasted with olives and whole garlic cloves. A traditional Toulouse family Sunday dish.
